query: What does this National Education Policy 2020 propose?
response: The National Education Policy 2020 proposes a systematic implementation of the policy led by various bodies including MHRD, CABE, Union and State Governments, education-related Ministries, State Departments of Education, Boards, NTA, the regulatory bodies of school and higher education, NCERT, SCERTs, schools, and HEIs. The implementation will be guided by principles such as implementing the spirit and intent of the Policy being the most critical matter, phased implementation of policy initiatives, and prioritization to ensure successful execution. The policy also addresses the unfinished agenda of the National Policy on Education 1986, modified in 1992 (NPE 1986/92), and takes into account the Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act 2009 which aims for universal elementary education.
